mapper.select: SELECT c.child_id AS childId, c.name AS name, c.profile_image_url AS profileImageUrl FROM child c INNER JOIN member m ON m.member_id = c.member_id WHERE c.member_id = #{memberId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.member_type = 'CHILD' LIMIT 1

SELECT fa.financial_account_id AS accountId, fa.balance AS accountBalance, fa.child_access_mode AS childUsageMode, fa.child_available_amount AS monthlyBudgetAmount, COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN tx.direction = 'DEBIT' AND tx.occurred_at >= #{startOccurredAt} AND tx.occurred_at < #{endOccurredAtExclusive} THEN tx.amount ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS currentMonthSpentAmount FROM financial_account fa LEFT JOIN account_transaction tx ON tx.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id WHERE fa.child_id = #{childId} AND fa.owner_type = 'CHILD' AND fa.account_product_type = 'DEMAND_DEPOSIT' AND fa.account_status = 'ACTIVE' AND fa.link_status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY fa.financial_account_id, fa.balance, fa.child_access_mode, fa.child_available_amount, fa.linked_at ORDER BY fa.is_primary DESC, fa.linked_at DESC, fa.financial_account_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mission WHERE child_id = #{childId} AND status IN ( 'ASSIGNED', 'SUBMITTED', 'REJECTED' )

SELECT mission_id AS missionId, title AS title, description AS description, reward_amount AS rewardAmount, status AS status FROM mission WHERE child_id = #{childId} AND status != 'CANCELED' ORDER BY mission_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND is_read = 0
